theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_tb_eval_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (z : ℂ) (b : ℝ), 0 ≤ b → (∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, ‖MvPolynomial.coeff d R.val‖ ≤ b) → ‖MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -z) R.val‖ ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (max 1 ‖z‖) ^ n * b
theorems.natural_summary: Homogeneity gives d 0 + d 1 = n on the support. Mapping each exponent pair to d 1 injects the support into {0,…,n}, so there are at most n+1 terms. Each evaluated term has norm at most b·max(1,‖z‖)^n. Expanding evaluation and applying the triangle inequality gives the claimed bound, including n=0.
